payload.gloss: the concept lattice C: every live concept with its anchor, gloss and factors. Its laws: one live concept per anchor, and a withdrawn concept keeps its anchor until reinstated; factors form a set, are acyclic and name live concepts, so a concept that others factor on cannot be retracted; every gloss and every reason is non-empty. The design knows nothing of plans. Only the architect writes it; a planner, implementer, assayer or integrator that meets divergence, incoherence or any other finding captures it as a note and never resolves it; the architect treats it as a hypothesis.
